def snap(f):
    P=None; blk={}
    for n in f.segmentation['nodes']:
        b=n['boundary']; rs=[p[0] for p in b]; cs=[p[1] for p in b]
        if n['color']=='M' and n['pixels']==18 and min(rs)<54: P=min(rs)
        if n['color'] in ('R','b','N') and n['pixels']==16 and min(rs)<54:
            blk[n['color']]=(min(rs),min(cs))
    return P, blk
print('before:', snap(current_frame))
res = action(['LEFT'])
print('after LEFT:', snap(current_frame), 'changed:', last_action_result.get('board_changed'))
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

def snap(f):
    P=None; blk={}
    for n in f.segmentation['nodes']:
        b=n['boundary']; rs=[p[0] for p in b]; cs=[p[1] for p in b]
        if n['color']=='M' and n['pixels']==18 and min(rs)<54: P=min(rs)
        if n['color'] in ('R','b','N') and n['pixels']==16 and min(rs)<54:
            blk[n['color']]=(min(rs),min(cs))
    return P, blk
